scope_limit: ControlDrift is currently bounded to reviewing supplied control baselines, current control evidence, change records and declared exceptions to identify evidence-backed drift candidates for human review. It does not determine control effectiveness, approve remediation, waive controls, execute configuration changes, or issue a compliance attestation.
review_pack_title: DIO ControlDrift Controlled Evidence Review Pack
human_gate_reason: Control-effectiveness conclusions, remediation approval, waivers, configuration changes, compliance attestations and final release remain with authorised control owners and reviewers.
